question: When was the Council of States (Rajya Sabha) constituted for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 April 1952**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term of members of Rajya Sabha is 6 years and one-third members retire after every 2 years__.

 __
 
• Also, one-third of Rajya Sabha members retire every 2 years, so the total tenure should be three times that of two years.
 
• The 'Council of States' also known as Rajya Sabha, a nomenclature announced by the Chairman in the House on 23 August 1954, has its own distinctive features.
 
 
• The origins of the Second House can be traced back to the Montagu-Chelmsford Report of 1918.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Qualifications of Rajya Sabha Member:

 
 
• Article 84 of the Constitution lays down the qualifications for membership in Parliament. 
 
• A person to be qualified for membership of the Rajya Sabha should possess the following qualifications:
 
 
• he must be a citizen of India and make and subscribe before some person authorized on that behalf by the Election Commission an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the Third Schedule to the Constitution;
 
• he must be not less than 30 years of age;
 
• he must possess such other qualifications as may be prescribed on that behalf by or under any law made by Parliament.
